author: FChecklist
body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'Stop routing killed-task RCA through code quality-gate auto-fix loop' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  STATUS_REPORT.md | 152 ++++++++++++++++++++++++-------------------------------
 1 file changed, 65 insertions(+), 87 deletions(-)
Evidence Recorded: This diff is a stale, duplicate rewrite of STATUS_REPORT.md: its base ('-' side) is the old PR #136 merge-recheck content from commit 46fe3d8, but current master (HEAD 2d2b125, 'docs: reverify already-shipped RCA/quality-gate routing fix') has already replaced that with content that says essentially the same thing this diff's '+' side says -- same UMR id (UMR-20260813-115911-df5c), same conclusion (fix from 037908b/PR #145 is live, blanket-exemption premise still wrong, all 3 target tasks still blocked on real capacity not misrouting). This task's own SPEC/report explicitly documents that this repo's STATUS_REPORT.md convention is a full-file rewrite per task and that concurrent full-file rewrites of it are a known, real collision/regression risk -- and this diff is itself an instance of exactly that: it was generated against a base that predates 2d2b125 and never checked current master state before producing near-duplicate content. Merging it now would either fail as a real conflict (STATUS_REPORT.md diverged) or, if force-applied, would silently discard/overwrite 2d2b125's already-merged reverification with a redundant rewrite, which is a real regression under this repo's own stated convention, not a cosmetic issue. No code changes are present in the diff (docs-only, correctly tier1), so there is no lint/build/security exposure, but the diff should not be merged as-is. Issues found: Diff's base content ('-' side) does not match current master HEAD (2d2b125); this branch predates that commit and was never rebased/re-checked against it before submission, violating the standing 'no duplication/no collision' rule (check existing task state before producing overlapping-scope work).; The '+' side substantively duplicates work already merged in commit 2d2b125 ('docs: reverify already-shipped RCA/quality-gate routing fix (UMR-20260813-115911-df5c)') -- same UMR, same verdict, same 3 target tasks, same evidence -- so merging adds no new information and risks clobbering the already-live version.; Per this repo's own documented STATUS_REPORT.md convention (each task fully rewrites the file rather than appending), landing this diff on top of current master would either produce a real merge conflict or silently regress the live file to a redundant duplicate -- the exact failure mode this diff's own removed text warns about.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
